coordinate_system: Unity world, metres, Y up; terrain centred on origin

understory_counts.note: ferns, grass tufts and fallen branches are ground-level visuals without colliders; shrubs (legacy) have no colliders; see midstory for collidable stems

surrounding_landscape.note: visual only, layer EnvironmentFar(14), no colliders, excluded from ground truth

midstory.note: shrubs and young conifers 1.5-4 m, stems have MeshColliders on layer Environment; leaf/needle cards have none. segments are capsules [ax,ay,az,bx,by,bz,radius_m] (mid-height 0.3-5.5 m, radius>=4 mm); crown_radius_m is the visual foliage extent
